necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome and a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, corresponding to diagnosis codes Z86.73 and I49.5. Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to optimize rate control management. This clinical indication justifies the medical necessity of the service despite the denial based on Reason Code CO-197.
